</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact001084" name="us-gaap:TransfersAndServicingOfFinancialAssetsTextBlock"><p id="xdx_807_eus-gaap--TransfersAndServicingOfFinancialAssetsTextBlock_zrgoxQECcJUj" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Note
6. <span id="xdx_828_zhabojsgxtBa">Distribution of Assets to CVR Trust</span></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>&#160;</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">As
discussed above, the Company distributed a significant portion of its legacy assets to the CVR Trust in connection with the creation
of CVRs for the benefit of the Company&#8217;s stockholders as of August 8, 2025. The CVR Trust is a Delaware statutory trust. The Management
Committee of the CVR Trust will manage the liquidation and monetization of the CVR Trust&#8217;s assets, whether such assets are held
directly by the CVR Trust or indirectly through the CVR Trust&#8217;s wholly-owned subsidiary, FG CVR SpinCo, LLC, a Delaware limited
liability company (the &#8220;SpinCo&#8221;). The CVR Trust is the sole member and manager of SpinCo.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Management
evaluated whether the Company is required to consolidate the CVR Trustunder ASC 810. Management concluded that although the CVR Trust
qualifies as a variable interest entity (&#8220;VIE&#8221;) pursuant to ASC 810, the Company is not the primary beneficiary as the Company
does not hold a variable interest and does not possess both (1) power over significant activities and (2) exposure to potentially significant
benefits or losses. Accordingly, consolidation is not required.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact001108" name="us-gaap:DisposalGroupsIncludingDiscontinuedOperationsDisclosureTextBlock"><p id="xdx_803_eus-gaap--DisposalGroupsIncludingDiscontinuedOperationsDisclosureTextBlock_zYo8128xFCRe" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Note
7. <span id="xdx_822_zcTPL9A2NNG6">Discontinued Operations</span></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>&#160;</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>Reinsurance</i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company&#8217;s wholly owned reinsurance subsidiary, FG Reinsurance Ltd (&#8220;FGRe&#8221;), a Cayman Islands limited liability company,
provides specialty property and casualty reinsurance. FGRe has been granted a Class B (iii) insurer license in accordance with the terms
of The Insurance Act (as revised) of the Cayman Islands and underlying regulations thereto and is subject to regulation by the Cayman
Islands Monetary Authority (the &#8220;Authority&#8221;). The terms of the license require advance approval from the Authority should
FGRe wish to enter into any reinsurance agreements which are not fully collateralized.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">During
the fourth quarter of 2024, the Board approved a plan to evaluate the potential sale of the Company&#8217;s reinsurance business. As
a result, management evaluated the classification of its reinsurance business as a discontinued operation as of December 31, 2024 and
determined the reinsurance business is a component of an entity and represented a discontinued operation. Accordingly, the reinsurance
business has been included as part of discontinued operations for all periods presented.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On
March 14, 2025, the Company entered into an agreement for the sale of the entire issued share capital of FG RE Corporate Member Limited
and for the planned commutation of its Lloyds of London reinsurance treaties UHA 251 22, B1868HT2300259, and B1868HT2400259. The transaction
closed during the second quarter of 2025, and the Company received consideration of $<span id="xdx_90E_eus-gaap--BusinessCombinationConsiderationTransferred1_pn5n6_c20250401__20250630__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--CorporateAndCommutationsOfTreatiesMember_zJlHzYDBBps2"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:BusinessCombinationConsiderationTransferred1" contextRef="From2025-04-012025-06-30_custom_CorporateAndCommutationsOfTreatiesMember" id="Fact001109" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">5.6</ix:nonFraction></span>&#160;million. In October 2025, the Company entered
into an agreement to sell the remaining portion of its reinsurance business. Pursuant to the agreements, the Company will receive (1)
the release of $<span id="xdx_905_eus-gaap--ReinsuranceRetentionExcessRetentionAmountReinsuredPerEvent_pn5n6_c20251001__20251031_zrswXJkbbOIg" title="Reinsurance contract"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ReinsuranceRetentionExcessRetentionAmountReinsuredPerEvent" contextRef="From2025-10-012025-10-31" id="Fact001111" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">3.3</ix:nonFraction></span>&#160;million of collateral that the Company had posted in connection with certain reinsurance contracts; (2) the
payment of $<span id="xdx_90A_ecustom--PaymentForReinsuranceContract_pn5n6_c20251001__20251031_z8BJsg0LgROe" title="Payment for reinsurance contract"><ix:nonFraction name="FGNX:PaymentForReinsuranceContract" contextRef="From2025-10-012025-10-31" id="Fact001113" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">1.0</ix:nonFraction></span>&#160;million in cash; and (3) a&#160;<span id="xdx_909_eus-gaap--ReinsuranceRetentionPolicyExcessRetentionPercentage_pid_dp_c20251001__20251031_zZKEA6Rhgd8e" title="Percantage of entity purchasing reinsurance business"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ReinsuranceRetentionPolicyExcessRetentionPercentage" contextRef="From2025-10-012025-10-31" id="Fact001115" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">40</ix:nonFraction></span>% equity interest in the entity purchasing the reinsurance business. Additionally,
pursuant to the agreements, the Company agreed to leave $<span id="xdx_90B_ecustom--ReinsuranceBusinessInExchange_pn5n6_c20251001__20251031_zymxiy8lAzvc" title="Reinsurance business in exchange"><ix:nonFraction name="FGNX:ReinsuranceBusinessInExchange" contextRef="From2025-10-012025-10-31" id="Fact001117" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">1.3</ix:nonFraction></span>&#160;million dollars in cash in the reinsurance business in exchange for
a promissory note in the amount of $<span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--DebtConversionConvertedInstrumentAmount1_pn5n6_c20251001__20251031_zqMjkClmdNT8" title="Promissory note"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DebtConversionConvertedInstrumentAmount1" contextRef="From2025-10-012025-10-31" id="Fact001119" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">1.3</ix:nonFraction></span>&#160;million that accrues interest at a rate of&#160;<span id="xdx_90F_eus-gaap--DebtConversionOriginalDebtInterestRateOfDebt_pid_dp_c20251001__20251031_zunyKxvdM652" title="Interest rate"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DebtConversionOriginalDebtInterestRateOfDebt" contextRef="From2025-10-012025-10-31" id="Fact001121" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">6</ix:nonFraction></span>% per annum with all principal and accrued

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>&#160;</i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">During
the fourth quarter of 2024, the Company recorded an impairment charge of approximately $<span id="xdx_90B_eus-gaap--AssetImpairmentCharges_pn5n6_c20241001__20241231_z2YPj58dKLV1" title="Impairment charge"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:AssetImpairmentCharges" contextRef="From2024-10-012024-12-31" id="Fact001123" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">2.1</ix:nonFraction></span>&#160;million to adjust the carrying amount

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>&#160;</i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>Strong
Technical Services, Inc.</i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>&#160;</i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On

determined it is a component of an entity and represented a discontinued operation. Accordingly, the managed services segment. is included
as part of discontinued operations in the accompanying consolidated financial statements.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Management

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>Strong
Studios</i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
March 2022, Strong Studios acquired, from Landmark Studio Group LLC (&#8220;Landmark&#8221;), the rights to original feature films and
television series, and was assigned third party rights to content for global multiplatform distribution.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
September 2023, the Company acquired all of the outstanding capital stock of Unbounded Media Corporation (&#8220;Unbounded&#8221;), an
independent media and creative production company.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">As
of December 31, 2023, the board of directors of Strong Global Entertainment approved the Company&#8217;s plan to exit its content business,
including Strong Studios and Unbounded and authorized management to proceed with such plan. As a result, management evaluated the classification
of Strong Studios as a discontinued operation as of December 31, 2023 and determined Strong Studios is a component of an entity and represented
a discontinued operation. Accordingly, Strong Studios has been included as part of discontinued operations for all periods presented.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">The Company determined that the disposal of the entities
described above are considered a strategic shift that will have a major effect on the Company&#8217;s operations and financial results
because these businesses historically represented a significant portion of the Company&#8217;s revenues and assets and operated as distinct
lines of business.</p>

during the year ended December 31, 2025 and December 31, 2024, respectively. The Company made capital contributions of approximately

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Certain
holdings owned by our former equity method investees were valued using Monte-Carlo simulation and option pricing models. Inherent in
Monte-Carlo simulation and option pricing models are assumptions related to expected volatility and discount for lack of marketability
of the underlying holding. Our former investees estimated the volatility of these holdings based on the historical performance of various
broad market indices blended with various peer companies which they considered as having similar characteristics to the underlying holding,
as well as consideration of price and volatility of relevant publicly traded securities such as SPAC warrants. Our former investees also
considered the probability of a successful merger when valuing equity for SPACs that had not yet closed.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">GreenFirst
Forest Products Inc. (&#8220;GreenFirst&#8221;) is a publicly-traded Canadian company focused on environmentally sustainable forest management
and lumber production. The Company held shares of GreenFirst directly that were accounted for at fair value based on observable quoted
market prices. The Company also held GreenFirst common shares through an equity method holding in GreenFirst Forest Products Holdings
LLC (see Equity Method Holdings below).</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">iCoreConnect
Inc. (&#8220;iCoreConnect&#8221;) is a cloud-based software and technology company focused on increasing workflow productivity and customer
profitability through its enterprise platform of applications and services. The Company held shares of iCoreConnect directly that are
accounted for at fair value based on observable quoted market prices. The Company also held iCoreConnect shares and warrants through
an equity method holding in FGMP (see Equity Method Holdings below).</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">OppFi
Inc. (&#8220;OppFi&#8221;) is a publicly-traded tech-enabled, mission-driven specialty finance platform that broadens the reach of community
banks to extend credit access to everyday Americans. The Company accounted for its common shares and warrants of OppFi using the fair
value method based on observable quoted market prices.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i><span style="text-decoration: underline">Cost
Method Holdings without Readily Determinable Fair Value</span></i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Each
of the Company&#8217;s cost method holdings were transferred to the CVR Trust in August 2025 and are no longer held by the Company. See
Note 6 for additional details.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
addition to our equity method and fair value method holdings, other holdings which do not have a readily determinable fair value were
accounted for at their cost, subject to any adjustment from time to time due to impairment or observable price changes in orderly transactions.
When the Company observed an orderly transaction of an investee&#8217;s identical or similar equity securities, the Company adjusted
the carrying value based on the observable price as of the transaction date. Any profit distributions the Company received on these holdings
were included in net holdings income. Management was not aware of any issuances of identical or similar equities during 2025. As a result,
the carrying value of holdings without readily determinable fair value did not change during 2025.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt/100% Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><i>Other</i></p>

<p style="font: 10pt/100% Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>
<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: center"></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company&#8217;s other holdings included a convertible promissory note and a senior unsecured promissory note.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On
September 29, 2023, the Company invested $<span id="xdx_90C_eus-gaap--ConvertibleNotesPayable_iI_c20230929_zK5hkGKc9TSf" title="Convertible promissory note"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ConvertibleNotesPayable" contextRef="AsOf2023-09-29" id="Fact001528" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" unitRef="USD">250,000</ix:nonFraction></span>&#160;in a convertible promissory note with ThinkMarkets, all of which was repaid during
2025.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On
March 16, 2023, the Company invested $<span id="xdx_904_eus-gaap--UnsecuredDebt_iI_c20230316__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--CraveworthyMember_zxhT8rNy7E2i" title="Unsecured loan"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:UnsecuredDebt" contextRef="AsOf2023-03-16_custom_CraveworthyMember" id="Fact001530" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" unitRef="USD">200,000</ix:nonFraction></span>&#160;in a senior unsecured loan to Craveworthy LLC (&#8220;Craveworthy&#8221;). The loan
had an interest rate of&#160;<span id="xdx_90F_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentInterestRateEffectivePercentage_iI_pid_dp_uPure_c20230316_z9ebDd5sPb1l" title="Interest rate"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateEffectivePercentage" contextRef="AsOf2023-03-16" id="Fact001532" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">13</ix:nonFraction></span>% and a maturity of&#160;<span id="xdx_90E_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentMaturityDate_dd_c20230316__20230316_zs48mk2VBt3d" title="Maturity date"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2023-03-162023-03-16" format="ixt:datemonthdayyearen" id="Fact001534" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentMaturityDate">March 15, 2024</ix:nonNumeric></span>. the maturity date to April 16, 2025. The Company expected the maturity date would be extended again, however, the loan was transferred

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>Impairment</i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">For
equity securities without readily determinable fair values, impairment is determined via a qualitative assessment which considers indicators
to evaluate whether the holding is impaired. Some of these indicators include a significant deterioration in the earnings performance
or asset quality of the investee, a significant adverse change in regulatory, economic or general market conditions in which the investee
operates, or doubt over an investee&#8217;s ability to continue as a going concern. If the holding is deemed to be impaired after conducting
this analysis, management would estimate the fair value of the holding to determine the amount of impairment loss.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">For
equity method holdings, evidence of a loss in value might include a series of operating losses of an investee, the absence of an ability
to recover the carrying amount of the holding, or a deterioration in the value of the investee&#8217;s underlying assets. If these, or
other indicators, lead to the conclusion that there is a decrease in the value of the holding that is other than temporary, the Company
would recognize that decrease in value even though the decrease may be in excess of what would otherwise be recognized under the equity
method of accounting.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
risks and uncertainties inherent in the assessment methodology used to determine impairment include, but may not be limited to, the following:</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: center; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><p id="xdx_8A8_zbQ0WnqyTC6i" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>&#160;</i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>Fair
Value Measurements</i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company determines fair value based on assumptions that market participants would use in pricing an asset or liability in the principal
or most advantageous market. The FASB has issued guidance that defines fair value as the exchange price that would be received for an
asset (or paid to transfer a liability) in the principal, or most advantageous market in an orderly transaction between market participants.
This guidance also establishes a fair value hierarchy that requires an entity to maximize the use of observable inputs and minimize the
use of unobservable inputs when measuring fair value. The guidance categorizes assets and liabilities at fair value into one of three
different levels depending on the observation of the inputs employed in the measurements, as follows:</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<table cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top">
    <td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 48px; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></td>
    <td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 24px; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#9679;</span></td>
    <td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Level
    1 &#8211; inputs to the valuation methodology are quoted prices for identical assets or liabilities in active markets providing the
    most reliable measurement of fair value since it is directly observable.</span></td></tr>
  <tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top">
    <td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></td>
    <td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></td>
    <td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></td></tr>
  <tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top">
    <td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></td>
    <td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#9679;</span></td>
    <td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Level
    2 &#8211; inputs to the valuation methodology which include quoted prices for similar assets or liabilities in active markets. These
    inputs are observable, either directly or indirectly, for substantially the full-term of the financial instrument.</span></td></tr>
  <tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top">
    <td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></td>
    <td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></td>
    <td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></td></tr>
  <tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top">
    <td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></td>
    <td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#9679;</span></td>
    <td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Level
    3 &#8211; inputs to the valuation methodology which are unobservable and significant to the measurement of fair value.</span></td></tr>
  </table>
<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
availability of valuation techniques and observable inputs can vary from holding to holding and are affected by a variety of factors,
including the type of holding, whether the holding is new and not yet established in the marketplace, the liquidity of markets and other
characteristics specific to the individual holding. In some cases, the inputs used to measure fair value might be categorized within
different levels of the fair value hierarchy. In those instances, the fair value measurement is categorized in its entirety in the hierarchy
based on the lowest level input that is significant to the fair value measurement. When determining fair value, the Company uses valuation
techniques that maximize the use of observable inputs and minimize the use of unobservable inputs.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

instruments measured, on a recurring basis, at fair value in accordance with the guidance promulgated by the FASB as of December 31,
2025 and December 31, 2024 are as follows (in thousands):</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><p id="xdx_8A6_z4PMNqwYNQIg" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: center"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
majority of state payments in 2024 were to Georgia and Illinois. All foreign tax payments were related to Canada, for 2025 $<span id="xdx_905_eus-gaap--IncomeTaxPaidForeignBeforeRefundReceived_pn5n6_c20250101__20251231__srt--StatementGeographicalAxis__country--CA_zZ59Ace3DZm7" title="Deferred tax liability"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:IncomeTaxPaidForeignBeforeRefundReceived" contextRef="From2025-01-012025-12-31_country_CA" id="Fact001852" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">0.8</ix:nonFraction></span> million
was related to withholding tax for remitting Canadian earnings to the U.S. and the remaining $<span id="xdx_906_ecustom--IncomeTaxPaidForeignForIncomeTaxReturns_pn5n6_c20240101__20241231__srt--StatementGeographicalAxis__country--CA_zXorhnV8CjBf" title="Income tax paid ,income tax returns"><ix:nonFraction name="FGNX:IncomeTaxPaidForeignForIncomeTaxReturns" contextRef="From2024-01-012024-12-31_country_CA" id="Fact001854" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">0.4</ix:nonFraction></span> million was related to annual Canadian
income tax returns. In 2024, all of the foreign payments were related to annual Canadian income tax returns.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
tax expense/benefit related to the managed services and reinsurance businesses has been allocated to discontinued operation. The Company
has sufficient net operating losses to offset materially the taxable income/loss from these discontinued operations, all of which is
offset by valuation allowance.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">As
a result of the Private Placement Offering, the Company underwent an ownership change as defined under Internal Revenue Code Section
382 (&#8220;Section 382&#8221;). As a result, the Company&#8217;s ability to utilize its Federal net operating loss and capital loss
carryforwards in future years is subject to an annual limitation. The estimated base limitation under Section 382 on the future utilization of net operating losses generated prior
to the ownership change is approximately $<span id="xdx_908_ecustom--FutureUtilizationOfNetOperatingLossesPriorToOwnershipChangeAmount_iI_pn5n6_c20251231_z8ZfK7OMiqNj" title="Future utilization of net operating losses prior to ownership change amount"><ix:nonFraction name="FGNX:FutureUtilizationOfNetOperatingLossesPriorToOwnershipChangeAmount" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31" id="Fact001856" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">0.5</ix:nonFraction></span> million per year. This limitation is calculated based on the value of the Company&#8217;s
stock immediately before the deemed ownership change, multiplied by the applicable long-term tax-exempt rate, and may be subject to further
adjustment as provided under Section 382 and related regulations. Due to the application of these limitations and the carryforward
periods for Federal net operating loss and capital loss carryforwards, the gross deferred tax asset related to net operating losses
has been reduced by $<span id="xdx_90A_ecustom--DecreaseInDeferredTaxAssetsRelatingToNetOperatingLoss_iI_pn5n6_c20251231_zxA1wYJhDONh" title="Decrease in deferred tax assets relating to net operating loss"><ix:nonFraction name="FGNX:DecreaseInDeferredTaxAssetsRelatingToNetOperatingLoss" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31" id="Fact001858" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">1.9</ix:nonFraction></span>
million, and the gross deferred tax asset related to capital losses has been reduced by $<span id="xdx_906_ecustom--DecreaseInDeferredTaxAssetsRelatingToCapitalLosses_iI_pn5n6_c20251231_zx7VgwYSG88b" title="Decrease in deferred tax assets relating to capital losses"><ix:nonFraction name="FGNX:DecreaseInDeferredTaxAssetsRelatingToCapitalLosses" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31" id="Fact001860" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">10.0</ix:nonFraction></span>
million.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
assessing the realizability of deferred tax assets, the Company considers whether it is more likely than not that some portion or all
of the deferred tax assets will not be realized. The ultimate realization of deferred tax assets is dependent upon the generation of
future taxable income. The Company considers the scheduled reversal of taxable temporary differences, projected future taxable income
and tax planning strategies in making this assessment. A cumulative loss in a particular jurisdiction in recent years is a significant
piece of evidence with respect to the realizability that is difficult to overcome. Based on the available objective evidence including
recent updates to the taxing jurisdictions generating income, the Company concluded that a valuation allowance of $<span id="xdx_905_eus-gaap--DeferredTaxAssetsValuationAllowance_iI_pn5n6_c20251231__srt--StatementGeographicalAxis__country--US_z1WTWuYfDnb2" title="deferred tax assets valuation allowance"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DeferredTaxAssetsValuationAllowance" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31_country_US" id="Fact001862" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">28.3</ix:nonFraction></span> million should
be recorded against the Company&#8217;s U.S. tax jurisdiction deferred tax assets as of December 31, 2025. The valuation allowance covers
substantially all U.S. net deferred tax assets. The remaining deferred items that are realizable are the deferred tax liabilities for
Canadian withholding tax and Canadian fixed assets. The overall change in valuation allowance is driven primarily by deferred tax impacts
of unrealized fair value changes in ETH holdings and the increase in current year net operating losses. The effective tax rate above
relates only to continuing operations.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company recorded a deferred tax liability related to withholding tax on the repatriation of earnings from its Canadian subsidiary of
$<span id="xdx_909_eus-gaap--DeferredTaxLiabilities_iI_pn5n6_c20251231__srt--StatementGeographicalAxis__country--CA_zCpKjlpZ0lw6" title="Deferred tax liability"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DeferredTaxLiabilities" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31_country_CA" id="Fact001864" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">0.1</ix:nonFraction></span> million and $<span id="xdx_905_eus-gaap--DeferredTaxLiabilities_iI_pn5n6_c20241231__srt--StatementGeographicalAxis__country--CA_zgZJ3XVG37E7" title="Deferred tax liability"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DeferredTaxLiabilities" contextRef="AsOf2024-12-31_country_CA" id="Fact001866" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">2.2</ix:nonFraction></span> million at December 31, 2025 and December 31, 2024, respectively. The change in liability during 2025 was due to
distributions and withholding tax accrued and paid in 2025. This Canadian withholding tax expense is reported in the foreign tax effects
section of the summary of tax expense and rate reconciliation.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">A
provision of Tax Cuts and Jobs Act of 2017 (the &#8220;2017 Tax Act&#8221;) was the implementation of the Global Intangible-Low Taxed
Income Tax, or &#8220;GILTI.&#8221; The Company has elected to account for the impact of GILTI in the period in which the tax actually
applies to the Company. U.S. GAAP does not prescribe a single required approach for GILTI under ASC Topic 740; entities may either recognize
deferred taxes for temporary differences expected to reverse as GILTI or treat GILTI as a period cost. During the year ended December
31, 2025, the Company did not incur any additional taxable income as a result of this provision.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">As

million and $<span id="xdx_901_eus-gaap--OperatingLossCarryforwards_iI_pn5n6_c20241231__us-gaap--IncomeTaxAuthorityAxis__us-gaap--StateAndLocalJurisdictionMember_zQzMEtijivD6"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:OperatingLossCarryforwards" contextRef="AsOf2024-12-31_us-gaap_StateAndLocalJurisdictionMember" id="Fact001868" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">56.7</ix:nonFraction></span> million, respectively. July 2025, the One Big Beautiful Bill Act (&#8220;OBBBA&#8221;) was enacted and effective and made significant changes to Federal
tax laws, including certain changes that were effective for the 2025 tax year. Changes in tax laws are accounted for in the period
of enactment and the retroactive effects are recognized in these financial statements. There were no material income tax
consequences of this enacted legislation on the reporting period of these financial statements.</span></p>

11. <span id="xdx_828_zxJLtPho9J0l">Equity Incentive Plans</span></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>&#160;</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company&#8217;s 2021 Equity Incentive Plan (the &#8220;2021 Plan&#8221;) was originally approved by the Company&#8217;s stockholders
on October 1, 2021, and has subsequently been amended, most recently pursuant to Amendment No. 3 approved by stockholders on July 23,
2025, to increase the number of shares authorized for issuance under the 2021 Plan to&#160;<span id="xdx_903_eus-gaap--ExcessStockSharesAuthorized_iI_pn5n6_c20250723__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--TwentyThousandTwentyOneEquityIncentivePlanMember_zmNSsjPqfnw3" title="Number of shares authorized"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ExcessStockSharesAuthorized" contextRef="AsOf2025-07-23_custom_TwentyThousandTwentyOneEquityIncentivePlanMember" id="Fact001880" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="Shares">2.0</ix:nonFraction></span>&#160;million shares. The purpose of the
2021 Plan is to attract and retain directors, consultants, officers and other key employees of the Company and its subsidiaries and to
provide to such persons incentives and rewards for superior performance. The 2021 Plan is administered by the Compensation and Management
Resources Committee of the Board and has a term of ten years. The 2021 Plan awards may be in the form of stock options (which may be
incentive stock options or nonqualified stock options), stock appreciation rights (&#8220;SARs&#8221;), restricted shares, RSUs, and
other share-based awards. As of December 31, 2025, there were approximately&#160;<span id="xdx_90F_eus-gaap--CommonStockCapitalSharesReservedForFutureIssuance_iI_pn5n6_c20251231_zHL3nSynu4v7" title="Future issuance"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:CommonStockCapitalSharesReservedForFutureIssuance" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31" id="Fact001882" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="Shares">2.0</ix:nonFraction></span>&#160;million shares remaining available for future
issuance.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
addition, on March 24, 2023,&#160;<span id="xdx_902_ecustom--EmployeeStockPurchasePlanAdditionDescription_c20230324__20230324_zAGF2wMuhOkd" title="ESPP Plan, description"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2023-03-242023-03-24" id="Fact001884" name="FGNX:EmployeeStockPurchasePlanAdditionDescription">the Board approved an employee stock purchase plan (&#8220;FGF ESPP Plan&#8221;) whereby qualifying
employees can choose each year to have up to 5% of their annual base earnings withheld to purchase the Company&#8217;s common shares
in the open market. The Company matches 100% of the employee&#8217;s contribution amount after thirty days of employment.</ix:nonNumeric></span></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Total
stock-based compensation expense for the years ended December 31, 2025 and December 31, 2024 was approximately $<span id="xdx_904_eus-gaap--EmployeeBenefitsAndShareBasedCompensation_pn5n6_c20250101__20251231_z6ZnPQTxfiyi" title="Share based compensation expenses"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:EmployeeBenefitsAndShareBasedCompensation" contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" id="Fact001886" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">7.8</ix:nonFraction></span>&#160;million and
$<span id="xdx_905_eus-gaap--EmployeeBenefitsAndShareBasedCompensation_pn5n6_c20240101__20241231_zoXjeKhhGpmj" title="Share based compensation expenses"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:EmployeeBenefitsAndShareBasedCompensation" contextRef="From2024-01-012024-12-31" id="Fact001888" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">1.6</ix:nonFraction></span>&#160;million, respectively. The increase in stock-based compensation expense in the current period is primarily related to the issuance
of warrants in connection with the Private Placement Offering. See Note 12 for additional details. Effective July 31, 2025, the Compensation

During 2024</span></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">As
discussed in Notes 1 and 5, on February 29, 2024, FGF and FGH closed the plan of merger to combine the companies in an all-stock transaction.
In connection with the Merger, FGH common stockholders received one share of FGF common stock for each share of common stock of FGH held
by such stockholder. As a result, the Company issued approximately <span id="xdx_900_eus-gaap--StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesNewIssues_pn5n6_c20240229__20240229__us-gaap--StatementEquityComponentsAxis__us-gaap--CommonStockMember__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--FGFandFGHMember_z7eCHVHveHh6" title="Stock issued during the period , shares"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesNewIssues" contextRef="From2024-02-292024-02-29_us-gaap_CommonStockMember_custom_FGFandFGHMember" id="Fact002016" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="Shares">0.8</ix:nonFraction></span> million of its common shares to common stockholders of FGH.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">As
discussed in Note 1, on September 30, 2024, the Company and Strong Global Entertainment completed the Arrangement to combine the companies
in an all-stock transaction. In connection with the transaction, stockholders of Strong Global Entertainment received <span id="xdx_900_eus-gaap--StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesNewIssues_pn5n6_c20240930__20240930__us-gaap--StatementEquityComponentsAxis__us-gaap--CommonStockMember__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--StrongGlobalEntertainmentMember_zr4T4QvkkmK5" title="Stock issued during the period , shares"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesNewIssues" contextRef="From2024-09-302024-09-30_us-gaap_CommonStockMember_custom_StrongGlobalEntertainmentMember" id="Fact002018" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="Shares">1.5</ix:nonFraction></span> common shares
of the Company for each share of Strong Global Entertainment. As a result, the Company issued approximately <span id="xdx_90B_eus-gaap--StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesNewIssues_pn5n6_c20240930__20240930__us-gaap--StatementEquityComponentsAxis__us-gaap--CommonStockMember__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--FGNexusIncMember_z6phH1Y5FmF8" title="Stock issued during the period , shares"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesNewIssues" contextRef="From2024-09-302024-09-30_us-gaap_CommonStockMember_custom_FGNexusIncMember" id="Fact002020" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="Shares">0.1</ix:nonFraction></span> million of its common
shares to stockholders of Strong Global Entertainment.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>Warrants</i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In

Offering. The Company paid ThinkEquity a cash placement fee of $<span id="xdx_903_ecustom--CashPlacementFee_c20250101__20251231__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--PlacementAgencyAgreementMember_zYINqmVJrti3" title="Cash placement fee"><ix:nonFraction name="FGNX:CashPlacementFee" contextRef="From2025-01-012025-12-31_custom_PlacementAgencyAgreementMember" id="Fact002022" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" unitRef="USD">6,000,000</ix:nonFraction></span>, or&#160;<span id="xdx_90A_ecustom--CashPlacementFeePercentage_iI_pid_dp_uPure_c20251231__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--PlacementAgencyAgreementMember_zye6EpIBTThf" title="Cash placement fee"><ix:nonFraction name="FGNX:CashPlacementFeePercentage" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31_custom_PlacementAgencyAgreementMember" id="Fact002024" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">3.0</ix:nonFraction></span>% of the aggregate purchase price paid by the PIPE

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact002078" name="us-gaap:RelatedPartyTransactionsDisclosureTextBlock"><p id="xdx_80B_eus-gaap--RelatedPartyTransactionsDisclosureTextBlock_zhRUibP4Dpx7" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Note
13. <span id="xdx_82B_z7rbJDClGeh">Related Party Transactions</span></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>&#160;</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Related
party transactions are carried out in the normal course of operations and are measured in part by the amount of consideration paid or
received, as established and agreed by the parties. Except where disclosed elsewhere in these consolidated financial statements, the
following is a summary of related party transactions.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>&#160;</i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>Limited
Liability Company Interests</i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company participated as a limited partner in a fund that was unwound during 2023.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">As
a result of the winddown, the Company held a direct limited liability company interests in FGAC Investors LLC, FG Merger Investors LLC,
and GreenFirst Forest Products Holdings, LLC. Mr. Cerminara and Mr. Swets, the head of the Company&#8217;s merchant banking business,
serve as managers of FGAC Investors LLC and FG Merger Investors LLC, while Mr. Cerminara ultimately controls GreenFirst Forest Products
Holdings, LLC. The Company&#8217;s interest in each of these LLC&#8217;s was transferred to the CVR Trust in August 2025.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>FG
Merchant Partners</i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">FGMP
was formed to co-sponsor newly formed SPACs and other merchant banking clients with their founders or partners. Certain of our directors
and officers also hold limited partner interests in FGMP. Mr. Swets holds a limited partner interest through Itasca Financial LLC, an
advisory and investment firm for which Mr. Swets is managing member. Mr. Cerminara also holds a limited partner interest through Fundamental
Global, LLC (&#8220;FG LLC&#8221;), a holding company for which Mr. Cerminara is the manager and one of the members.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">FGMP
has invested in the founder shares and warrants of Aldel Financial Inc., FG Merger Corp, FG Acquisition Corp, Aldel Financial II Inc.,
FGC and Craveworthy. Certain of our directors and officers are affiliated with these entities. The Company&#8217;s ownership interest
in each of these entities was distributed to the CVR Trust in August 2025.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>FG
Communities</i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
October 2022, the Company directly invested $<span id="xdx_905_eus-gaap--Investments_iI_pn5n6_c20221031__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--FGCommunitiesIncMember_zLDEzjY9yv2e" title="Investments"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:Investments" contextRef="AsOf2022-10-31_custom_FGCommunitiesIncMember" id="Fact002080" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">2.0</ix:nonFraction></span>&#160;million into FGC, which was included in other holdings on the consolidated balance
sheet as of December 31, 2024. The Company also held an interest through its ownership in FGMP. As noted above, the Company&#8217;s ownership
interest in FGC was distributed to the CVR Trust in August 2025. FGC is a self-managed real estate company focused on a growing portfolio
of manufactured housing communities which are owned and operated by FGC. Mr. Cerminara is the President and a director of FGC.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>Craveworthy</i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On
March 16, 2023, the Company invested $<span id="xdx_904_eus-gaap--UnsecuredDebt_iI_pn5n6_c20230316__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--CraveworthyMember_zFJKCSTBc4bl" title="Senior unsecured promissory note"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:UnsecuredDebt" contextRef="AsOf2023-03-16_custom_CraveworthyMember" id="Fact002082" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">0.2</ix:nonFraction></span>&#160;million in a senior unsecured loan to Craveworthy. Mr. Swets has an indirect interest
in Craveworthy, independent from the interests held by the Company through its ownership in FGMP. As noted above, the Company&#8217;s
ownership interest in Craveworthy was distributed to the CVR Trust in August 2025.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>FG
Imperii Investors</i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>&#160;</i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">During
the third quarter of 2025, the Company entered into a promissory note with FG Imperii Investors LLC (&#8220;FGII&#8221;) pursuant to
which the Company agreed to loan approximately $<span id="xdx_902_eus-gaap--ProceedsFromLoans_pn5n6_c20250701__20250930__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--FGImperiiInvestorsLLCMember_zhyqUwvfqSyj" title="Senior unsecured promissory note"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ProceedsFromLoans" contextRef="From2025-07-012025-09-30_custom_FGImperiiInvestorsLLCMember" id="Fact002084" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">0.2</ix:nonFraction></span>&#160;million to FGII. FGII is the sponsor of FG Imperii Acquisition Corp., a SPAC
in the process of completing its initial public offering. The promissory note was payable on the date FG Imperii Acquisition Corp. consummates
its initial public offering, which occurred during January 2026. Certain of our directors and officers are affiliated with FGII.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>Saltire</i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company owns real estate in Canada that it leases to a wholly-owned subsidiary of Saltire. Pursuant to the terms of the lease, the Company
receives annual rental income of $<span id="xdx_90E_eus-gaap--RentalIncomeNonoperating_pn5n6_c20250101__20251231__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--SaltireHoldingsLtdMember_zUPEiXeKrDP4" title="Rental income"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:RentalIncomeNonoperating" contextRef="From2025-01-012025-12-31_custom_SaltireHoldingsLtdMember" id="Fact002086" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">0.4</ix:nonFraction></span>&#160;million. Mr. Swets, the head of the Company&#8217;s merchant banking business, serves as the
Executive Chair and is a member of the Board of Directors of Saltire. Mr. Cerminara, the Company&#8217;s Chief Executive Officer and
Chairman of the Company&#8217;s Board of Directors, and Richard Govignon, a member of the Company&#8217;s Board of Directors, serve as
members of the Board of Directors of Saltire.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>Shared
Services Agreement</i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On
March 31, 2020, the Company entered into a Shared Services Agreement (the &#8220;Shared Services Agreement&#8221;) with Fundamental Global
Management, LLC (&#8220;FGM&#8221;), an affiliate of FG LLC, pursuant to which FGM provides the Company with certain services related
to the day-to-day management of the Company, including assisting with regulatory compliance, evaluating the Company&#8217;s financial
and operational performance, providing a management team to supplement the executive officers of the Company, and such other services
consistent with those customarily performed by executive officers and employees of a public company. In exchange for these services,
the Company pays FGM a fee of $<span id="xdx_90E_ecustom--SharedServicesFee_c20200331__20200331__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--SharedServicesAgreementMember__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--FundamentalGlobalManagementLLCMember_zkEQcnqDlHUd" title="Shared services fee"><ix:nonFraction name="FGNX:SharedServicesFee" contextRef="From2020-03-312020-03-31_custom_SharedServicesAgreementMember_custom_FundamentalGlobalManagementLLCMember" id="Fact002088" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" unitRef="USD">456,000</ix:nonFraction></span>&#160;per quarter (the &#8220;Shared Services Fee&#8221;), plus reimbursement of expenses incurred
by FGM in connection with the performance of the services, subject to certain limitations approved by the Board or Compensation and Management
Resources Committee from time to time.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Shared Services Agreement has an initial term of three years, and thereafter renews automatically for successive one-year terms unless
terminated in accordance with its terms. The Shared Services Agreement may be terminated by FGM or by the Company, by a vote of the Company&#8217;s
independent directors, at the end of the initial or automatic renewal term upon 120 days&#8217; notice, subject to payment by the Company
of certain costs incurred by FGM to wind down the provision of services and, in the case of a termination by the Company without cause,
payment of a termination fee equal to the Shared Services Fee paid for the two quarters preceding termination. In the third quarter of
2022, the Shared Services Agreement was amended to eliminate termination fees and to increase the termination notice from 120 days to
365 days.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company paid $<span id="xdx_905_ecustom--SharedServicesFee_pn5n6_c20250101__20251231__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--SharedServicesAgreementMember__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--FundamentalGlobalManagementLLCMember_zK5Hykhg0b11" title="Shared services fee"><ix:nonFraction name="FGNX:SharedServicesFee" contextRef="From2025-01-012025-12-31_custom_SharedServicesAgreementMember_custom_FundamentalGlobalManagementLLCMember" id="Fact002090" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">2.5</ix:nonFraction></span> million and $<span id="xdx_900_ecustom--SharedServicesFee_pn5n6_c20240101__20241231__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--SharedServicesAgreementMember__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--FundamentalGlobalManagementLLCMember_zLHbL0i6Ciw8" title="Shared services fee"><ix:nonFraction name="FGNX:SharedServicesFee" contextRef="From2024-01-012024-12-31_custom_SharedServicesAgreementMember_custom_FundamentalGlobalManagementLLCMember" id="Fact002092" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">1.8</ix:nonFraction></span>&#160;million to FGM under the Shared Services Agreement during the year ended December 31, 2025 and
December 31, 2024, respectively. Payments made during the year ended December 31, 2025 included reimbursement of $<span id="xdx_90C_ecustom--ReimbursementOfExpenses_pn5n6_c20250101__20251231__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--SharedServicesAgreementMember__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--FundamentalGlobalManagementLLCMember_zDOi4ppmXHSe" title="Reimbursement of expenses"><ix:nonFraction name="FGNX:ReimbursementOfExpenses" contextRef="From2025-01-012025-12-31_custom_SharedServicesAgreementMember_custom_FundamentalGlobalManagementLLCMember" id="Fact002094" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">0.7</ix:nonFraction></span> million of certain
expenses incurred by FGM in connection with the Private Placement. These amounts are included in General and administrative expenses
on the consolidated statements of operations.</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact002096" name="us-gaap:EarningsPerShareTextBlock"><p id="xdx_807_eus-gaap--EarningsPerShareTextBlock_zK1nQxLurh5i" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Note
14. <span id="xdx_826_zoIq1OhcTAQ3">Earnings Per Share</span></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

basic and diluted earnings per share for the year ended December 31, 2025 and 2024 (in thousands, except per share amounts).</span></p>
